name: mindmaven-executive-os
description: Mindmaven Executive OS: one plugin per skill. Install mm-setup first, then the skills you want.

plugins.name: mm-calendar-review
plugins.description: Mindmaven Friday calendar review for an executive and their EA.

plugins.name: mm-calendar-upkeep
plugins.description: Mindmaven daily calendar maintenance for the next business day - every weekday afternoon it checks tomorrow's events for missing video links, addresses, or phone numbers, invitees who haven't accepted (especially outside preferred hours), overlaps, stale tentative (T) holds, last-minute changes i...

plugins.name: mm-edraft
plugins.description: Mindmaven eDrafts - turn the exec's voice note, rough notes, or a one-line ask ("draft a follow-up to Maria", "intro Sam to Maria", "say no to the panel invite nicely") into a polished email draft in the exec's own voice, ready to send.

plugins.name: mm-email-loop-scan
plugins.description: Daily scan of the user's email for open loops - open commitments the user is waiting on ("did Dana sign the contract we sent?", "did Maria send the deck she promised?", an intro or decision still pending) and personal moments in people's lives (trips, moves, new babies, weddings, a kid starting c...

plugins.name: mm-eod-update
plugins.description: Mindmaven end-of-day update - every weekday afternoon, one skimmable summary of the day for the exec - confirmations first (what got done, booked, sent, or closed), then decisions as yes/no questions with the stated assumption, tomorrow at a glance, loops captured today, and anything not handled ...

plugins.name: mm-loop-manager
plugins.description: Mindmaven Loop Leverage manager - the daily tickler-file pass.

plugins.name: mm-meeting-debrief
plugins.description: Turn any meeting (a recording or the exec's own voice dictation) into a Mindmaven debrief in APPA format - Action items given and received, Professional Challenges, Personal Interests & Passions, About/Facts - then create tasks and yes/no loop leverage tasks in the task tool, update each attendee...

plugins.name: mm-meeting-prebrief
plugins.description: Mindmaven prebriefs, delivered the morning of each call - a skimmable brief for every call that day (external in full, internal in three lines) with the basics (name, title and company, meeting type, icebreaker, how you met, link or location, backup cell), agenda plus a silent agenda of promises ...

plugins.name: mm-missed-task-scan
plugins.description: Daily scan of the user's email and Slack or Teams for things the user owes that never made it into their task tool - promises they made ("I'll send that over") and requests made of them - checked against every source so nothing already done gets suggested, deduped against existing tasks and dismi...

plugins.name: mm-preference-sheet
plugins.description: Builds and maintains Mindmaven's Executive Preference Document, the doc an EA works from - how the exec likes email written, calendar invites titled and colored, meetings scheduled and confirmed, travel booked, and what to never do.

plugins.name: mm-setup
plugins.description: Set up, onboard, and change settings for the Mindmaven Executive OS, a connected suite of scheduled skills (prebriefs, debriefs, morning scans, loop manager, eDrafts, daily calendar upkeep, end-of-day update, Friday calendar review) that work with the user's EA or delegate.
